newsitem.title: USA: BROWN GROUP SEES Q2 NET BELOW ESTIMATES.
newsitem.headline: BROWN GROUP SEES Q2 NET BELOW ESTIMATES.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday it expects to report 1997 second quarter earnings of $0.15 to $0.20 a share which is somewhat below analysts estimates.

The footwear retailer cited lower than planned sales at its Famous Footwear stores in both June and July along with lower than planned shipments during the quarter at the company's Pagoda wholesale business as the reasons for the second quarter shortfall.
However, the company said its outlook for the third quarter is more positive.

"As Brown Group moves into the critical third quarter, however, we are encouraged by Famous Footwear's early August back-to-school retail results, by improved Naturalizer retail performance, by our management of cash flow, which continues to be better than planned and by increasing customer acceptance of Brown Shoe Coompany's wholesale brands," said Harry Rich, executive vice president and chief financial officer.
The company reported July same store sales for its Famous Footwear division fell 2.1 percent from the comparable period last year while total sales rose 5.4 percent to $64.7 million.

The lower July same store sales reflects soft women's business and lower early back-to-school sales than last year, the company said. However, sales of children's footwear, particularly branded athletic shoes, have increased sharply in August and solid same store increases this month indicate that the back-to-school season, although late, is now underway, Brown Group added.
Shares of Brown Group were trading off 10/16 to 16-13/16.
